blocks.value: A company's share price rises when more people want to buy it than sell it. But what makes people suddenly want to buy a company?
Imagine This: A company launches an amazing new mobile phone that becomes a huge success. Investors believe the company will earn more profits in the future, so many people rush to buy its shares.
Good quarterly results, new products, higher profits, expansion plans, government support, and positive investor confidence can all increase demand for a stock.
If Infosys announces better-than-expected profits, investors may buy more shares, causing the price to rise.
Stock prices move based on what investors expect about the future, not only what happened today.
